with recursive menu_tree as ( select id from t_oneshot where id = #{siteRootId} and deleted = 0 union all select child.id from t_oneshot child inner join menu_tree parent on child.parent_id = parent.id where child.deleted = 0 ) update t_oneshot target inner join menu_tree tree on target.id = tree.id set target.site_project_id = null, target.site_root_id = null where target.site_project_id = #{siteProjectId} and target.site_root_id = #{siteRootId}
